model_annotation: The chart illustrates the negative log probability for a model fine-tuned on different medical specialties. The horizontal axis displays categories representing medical specialties: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, and Pediatrics. The vertical axis is labeled "Negative log probability" and displays values on a linear scale ranging from approximately -27 to -22. Tick labels are present at intervals of 1, showing values of -27, -26, -25, -24, and -23. Five sets of bars are presented, with each set representing a different fine-tuning condition. The bars representing "Cardio" are colored orange, "Gastro" are beige, "Infect" are light brown, "Neuro" are dark brown, and "Pediatrics" are a medium orange color. The bars are grouped by specialty, with each group containing five bars corresponding to the fine-tuning conditions indicated in the legend.  The bar representing the "Mistralv0.2-Base" fine-tuning on Cardio has a value of approximately -23.8, while the "Pediatrics" fine-tuning with that same dataset has a value of approximately -24.2. A general trend appears where the "Neuro" bars are consistently shorter than the others within each group, with the shortest bar measuring about -25.8. No bars are visually emphasized beyond color differentiation and consistent grouping.
